需要安装用户级 dsh Host

Desktop Host required — install user-level dsh (same stack as dsh --profile web). Wails will not use a packaged/monorepo host-main by default.

安装步骤 / Install steps

  1. Install @deepseek-ai/dsh under ~/.dsh or ~/dsh (or any folder you choose).
  2. Ensure one of: bin/dsh, bin/dsh-desktop, or node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js.
  3. Or set export DSH_HOME=/path/to/install / export DSH_BIN=/path/to/dsh.
  4. Restart Desktop, or click Retry discovery below.

Profile

  • Uses your existing user profile when present.
  • Otherwise starts with the web profile (dsh --profile web).

Desktop features that control/connect dsh run as tools/plugins against your user install — not a bundled Host inside the app package.
